title: SENSOR NOT FOUND
symptom: After changing sensor and replacing MiaoMiao, xDrip gives a 'SENSOR NOT FOUND' error, even though the sensor works fine on the Libre monitor. The error persists despite resetting and ensuring tight placement.
cause: The thread suggests it is likely a problem of the sensor in combination with Miaomiao and not related to xDrip.
evidence_quote: It looks like a problem of the sensor in combination with Miaomiao and not related to xDrip.
